content.rationale: S5-marker-append fixes what closing a bracket does to the state — the undone tail discarded at the position, then the operation's kind, targeted change and kept entry ids appended in run order with the position advanced to the new length — and S5-ordered that marker order is the order operations ran in; M-layout places the module flat at src/markers_append.rs. The linear history fixes the truncation (kpptprql). It names the state through M-markers' closed types, crosses the store through M-store, and reads and writes the whole file through M-markers-persist's load and save — never std::fs, never a truncate. One transition: read the live state, discard the markers after the position, append the operation's record at the new end in run order, set the position to the list's length, write the file back; a fresh marker records no reverts of its own. Every failure is M-markers-persist's carried reason, and this module never renders it.
